races.name: bet365 Handicap

runners_data.name: Calico Blue
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 287-day layoff needs pace collapse but has class edge with Varian/Dawson team.

runners_data.name: Old Is Gold
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong 5f record and Doyle booking, though 247 days off is a concern despite yard's patience.

runners_data.name: One And Gone
runners_data.note: Prominent type in good recent form but trainer struggling badly and lacks any course form.

runners_data.name: Atticum
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with decent recent form but 185-day break and needs strong pace to be effective.

runners_data.name: Hypnotised
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won last time but long absence and weak trainer form are negatives.

runners_data.name: Black Star Boy
runners_data.note: Natural leader who sets honest pace but hasn't won for long time and form has been disappointing.

runners_data.name: Sir Alfie
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with good recent course form and only 8 days since last run keeps him sharp.

runners_data.name: Ambishio
runners_data.note: Front-runner with progressive profile and recent wins, only 13 days off and well-handicapped.

runners_data.name: Underwriter
runners_data.note: Prominent type with class but noted for fading in finish and very long layoff is major concern.

races.paceDynamic: Black Star Boy and Ambishio will lock horns from the gates, setting a genuine gallop over this sharp 5f trip. Four horses (Old Is Gold, One And Gone, Hypnotised, Sir Alfie) all want prominent positions behind them, creating inevitable traffic problems turning for home. The honest pace set by the two leaders will stretch the field, with late-finishing types Calico Blue, Atticum and Underwriter needing the race to collapse. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can secure clean passage and kick when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet can secure good positions behind the duelling leaders.
scenarios.body: The honest pace will perfectly set up those tracking just behind, with Old Is Gold and Sir Alfie best positioned to strike when Black Star Boy and Ambishio weaken. Traffic won't be an issue for the well-placed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leaders Battle Home
scenarios.trigger: If Black Star Boy and Ambishio get competitive splits but one finds extra.
scenarios.body: The pace will be strong but sustainable over 5f, allowing the survivor to hold off the prominent pack in a thrilling finish. Class and form favour Ambishio who has been progressing nicely.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes unsustainably fast with the leaders going too hard.
scenarios.body: The race will collapse dramatically in the final furlong, allowing Calico Blue or Atticum to sweep through late. Both have the class but need everything to fall right given their layoff periods.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet gets badly hampered by the tight finish at Sandown.
scenarios.body: Underwriter or Hypnotised could benefit from a clear run when others are stopped, though both carry question marks. The pace collapse would need to be severe to bring them into play.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems at the 2f pole when Old Is Gold, One And Gone, Hypnotised and Sir Alfie all converge behind the leaders.
Monitor Black Star Boy and Ambishio's early sectionals - if they go too fast the race will collapse for hold-up horses.
Check if Calico Blue gets the strong pace he needs given his 287-day absence and hold-up style.
Watch Underwriter's finishing effort - his tendency to fade late could be exacerbated by the long layoff.
Observe how quickly Sir Alfie travels given his recent run just 8 days ago at this same course.

races.name: bet365 Esher Cup Handicap

runners_data.name: Organise
runners_data.note: Front runner in top form with James Doyle aboard, perfectly suited to dictate the pace from his natural position

runners_data.name: Nobody Knows
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with Ryan Moore's tactical expertise, well-suited to strong pace scenarios despite 38-day break

runners_data.name: Laureate Crown
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who showed excellent form last time, Oisin Murphy can utilize his strong finishing kick

runners_data.name: Look To The Stars
runners_data.note: Natural leader returning from 195-day absence, needs to prove fitness but has class and course experience

runners_data.name: Breathe Easy
runners_data.note: Non-runner, would have been a third pace angle

runners_data.name: Suspended Sentence
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 207-day break, strong finishing record but needs the pace to develop

runners_data.name: Goodwood Galaxy
runners_data.note: Hold-up type carrying top weight, proven at the level but facing lengthy absence concerns

runners_data.name: Capall Rasa
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent form, needs strong pace to be effective from his preferred back position

races.paceDynamic: Organise and Look To The Stars are confirmed front runners who will set a strong gallop from the start, with both carrying 132lbs in this competitive handicap. The presence of two natural pace-setters virtually guarantees an honest tempo that will test stamina over Sandown's stiff mile. This sustained gallop will suit horses with tactical speed who can position prominently without being caught up in early pace battles. The race shape clearly favours prominent racers and strong travellers who can secure good positions early, as hold-up horses will face a difficult task against the likely strong tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Organise and Look To The Stars both go forward and maintain a searching gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find out horses lacking stamina while setting up perfectly for those with tactical speed who can track the leaders without over-racing. Nobody Knows and Laureate Crown are best positioned to capitalize with their strong finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the two front runners go too fast early and falter in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where pure speed trumps stamina, allowing hold-up horses to make late gains. Goodwood Galaxy and Suspended Sentence can unleash powerful finishing efforts from off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Organise Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Organise can dictate moderate fractions while Look To The Stars struggles with the return from a long break
scenarios.body: The even tempo allows the class leader to control proceedings and kick clear when challenged. James Doyle can use Organise's recent winning form to maximum advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Look To The Stars Rebounds
scenarios.trigger: If Look To The Stars shows no rust from the 195-day layoff and William Buick positions him perfectly
scenarios.body: The Appleby horse can use his natural speed to dictate terms and prove his class despite the lengthy absence. His previous course form gives him a tactical edge.

watchPoints.text: Look To The Stars showing any signs of rustiness in the preliminaries after his 195-day layoff could eliminate a key pace factor
If Organise and Look To The Stars don't both go forward, the pace scenario changes dramatically and favours closers
Nobody Knows and Laureate Crown need to be positioned within striking distance turning for home to capitalize on the likely strong pace
Goodwood Galaxy carrying 135lbs needs a truly run race to overcome the weight burden from his hold-up style
The market will reveal any confidence behind the returning horses Suspended Sentence and Look To The Stars

races.name: bet365 Gordon Richards Stakes (Group 3)

runners_data.name: Saddadd
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning after 212 days off but boasts the highest recent RPR of 127 and Ray Dawson knows Sandown well

runners_data.name: King Of Cities
runners_data.note: Proven hold-up performer with Ryan Moore aboard, solid recent form including a win two runs back and handles good ground well

runners_data.name: Muddy Mooy
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who will press Devil's Advocate early, dropping in grade but trainer Charlie Pike is 0/7 in last 14 days

runners_data.name: Almeric
runners_data.note: Class hold-up horse with impressive hat-trick earlier this season, returning after 188 days but Oisin Murphy's booking catches the eye

runners_data.name: Devil's Advocate
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who will dictate the pace, recent runner-up suggests returning to form and William Buick partnership is strong

races.paceDynamic: Devil's Advocate will set a controlled pace from the front with only Muddy Mooy for company in the early stages, creating a relatively sedate gallop through the middle sections. The three hold-up horses (Saddadd, King Of Cities, Almeric) will be positioned well back, relying on Ryan Moore, Ray Dawson and Oisin Murphy to time their challenges perfectly. With such a small field and minimal early pace pressure, this tactical setup will produce a sprint finish from the 2f marker. This race shape strongly favours the prominent/front-running horses who can dictate terms and have less ground to make up in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Devil's Advocate or Muddy Mooy maintain their forward positions without serious pressure through halfway
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets first run on the field and holds off late challengers who have too much ground to make up in a slowly-run race. The prominent pair benefit from racing on the pace in a small field where hold-up tactics are compromised.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or the front pair go too fast early
scenarios.body: The prominently-raced horses tie up in the final furlong, allowing the class of Almeric or experience of King Of Cities to sweep past with Ryan Moore or Oisin Murphy timing their run to perfection. Superior ratings tell in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Saddadd Timing Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If Ray Dawson gets the fractions exactly right and Saddadd produces his best form returning from 212 days off
scenarios.body: The Roger Varian-trained horse overcomes his lengthy absence to deliver a well-timed challenge, benefiting from the highest recent RPR figure of 127. His hold-up style clicks in a race where the pace judgement proves crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Devil's Advocate and Muddy Mooy crawl early then kick for home simultaneously at the 3f pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical mess with the entire field bunched entering the straight, leading to interference or an unexpected winner emerging from the ruck. Form lines become irrelevant in a scrappy finish.

watchPoints.text: Devil's Advocate could get an uncontested lead if Muddy Mooy drops back early, making the front-runner very hard to peg back
King Of Cities needs Ryan Moore to find the right gap in the straight as hold-up horses can get trapped in small fields
Almeric's 188-day absence is a concern but the Oisin Murphy booking suggests connections expect a big run fresh
The pace could collapse completely with only two natural prominent runners, turning this into a tactical crawl
Saddadd's 212-day break is significant but Roger Varian's stable is in good form and the horse has winning fresh form

races.name: bet365 Mile (Group 2)

runners_data.name: Zeus Olympios
runners_data.note: Clear front-runner returning after 210 days off but trainer Burke has strong recent form and Moore's booking is significant

runners_data.name: Field Of Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with highest rating but 188-day absence and needs to overcome unfavorable pace scenario in small field

runners_data.name: Opera Ballo
runners_data.note: Prominent racer ideally placed to track Zeus Olympios and has good recent form including Group wins

runners_data.name: Never So Brave
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits if pace is strong but faces traffic concerns with so many similar runners behind the leaders

runners_data.name: Dancing Gemini
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor trainer form (1/7) and inconsistent recent performances including two poor efforts

runners_data.name: Cicero's Gift
runners_data.note: Another hold-up runner whose trainer struggles (1/14) and faces same tactical disadvantage as other back-markers

races.paceDynamic: Zeus Olympios will dictate from the front with only Opera Ballo likely to press him early, creating a comfortable rhythm through the first half-mile. The other four runners (Field Of Gold, Never So Brave, Dancing Gemini, Cicero's Gift) all prefer to come from off the pace, meaning no early pressure on the leader. Zeus Olympios can control the tempo and save energy for the finish, while the hold-up horses face the challenge of making up ground from similar positions. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will plague the back-markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Zeus Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Zeus Olympios dictates comfortable early fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The leader saves energy in front and kicks clear when the hold-up horses are still organizing their challenges. Opera Ballo benefits from tracking the pace and having first run on the closers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Opera Ballo Presses Forward
scenarios.trigger: If Opera Ballo goes forward to challenge Zeus Olympios earlier than expected
scenarios.body: The increased pace plays into the hands of the stronger hold-up horses who can pick up the pieces late. Field Of Gold's class edge becomes decisive in a strongly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Favours Class
scenarios.trigger: If Zeus Olympios goes very slowly and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint where pure ability matters most over tactical position. Field Of Gold's superior rating and Gosden training gives him the edge in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get blocked or come too wide in the straight
scenarios.body: The two with the clearest runs (Zeus Olympios in front, Opera Ballo tracking) fight out the finish. The back-markers' chances are compromised by poor positioning and racing room.

watchPoints.text: Zeus Olympios could steal this if he breaks cleanly and gets soft fractions with no early pressure from the prominent horses
Field Of Gold needs the pace to be strong early to suit his hold-up style but only Zeus Olympios looks likely to ensure that
Opera Ballo's early positioning will be crucial - if he tracks Zeus Olympios closely he avoids the hold-up horses' problems
The four hold-up horses could get in each other's way in the straight if they all come with runs simultaneously
Dancing Gemini and Cicero's Gift both represent trainers in poor current form which adds to their tactical disadvantages

races.name: bet365 Classic Trial (Group 3)

runners_data.name: Raaheeb
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 231 days which raises significant fitness concerns despite previous winning form.

runners_data.name: Al Zanati
runners_data.note: Quality prominent performer with strong recent form but faces 157-day absence and step up from shorter trips.

runners_data.name: Action
runners_data.note: Natural leader with Ryan Moore booking suggests confidence, though 181-day break and recent below-par efforts are concerns.

runners_data.name: Spyce
runners_data.note: Proven prominent runner over similar distances with relatively fresh 195-day break and solid recent form.

runners_data.name: Winding Stream
runners_data.note: Prominent type with major fitness advantage having run just 23 days ago, though low official rating presents class concerns.

runners_data.name: Wise Prince
runners_data.note: Lone hold-up runner faces tactical isolation but has winning form and strong Gosden/Havlin combination.

runners_data.name: Oceans Four
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer with good course form and proven stamina over this distance.

races.paceDynamic: Action appears the most natural front runner and will likely lead from the start, with Al Zanati, Oceans Four, and Spyce all positioned prominently behind. With only seven runners and most adopting prominent tactics, the pace should be honest but sustainable rather than destructive. Only Wise Prince is committed to hold-up tactics, leaving him potentially isolated at the back with limited company. This moderate gallop with Action controlling terms clearly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and have first run on the lone closer.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Action Controls Terms
scenarios.trigger: If Action gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The Ballydoyle runner can quicken off steady fractions with Ryan Moore timing his move perfectly. Prominent runners like Al Zanati and Oceans Four get ideal tactical positions but may lack the class edge to reel in Action.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Royal
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners press Action early and create stronger pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and brings stamina into play over this extended 1m2f trip. Oceans Four and Spyce, both proven over similar distances, can capitalise on a true-run race while Action may find the sustained pressure telling.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a sprint finish favouring closers
scenarios.body: Wise Prince gets the perfect scenario with a slow early gallop allowing him to unleash his finishing kick. The Gosden-trained runner has winning form over similar trips and Havlin can time his challenge from the back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders underperform after long absences
scenarios.body: Winding Stream, freshest of all having run just 23 days ago, can exploit any rustiness from rivals returning after 150+ day breaks. Raaheeb could also benefit despite his 231-day layoff given his previous winning form.

watchPoints.text: Action's jumping off in front could see him steal a big lead if rivals are slow to respond early
Wise Prince getting completely detached at the back with no other hold-up runners for company tactically
Al Zanati's settling early given his tendency to race prominently and Buick's need to secure good position
The pace through the first half-mile as multiple prominent runners could create unsustainable early fractions
Winding Stream's fitness advantage showing late as longer-absent rivals may tire in the final furlong

races.name: bet365 "Wild Card" Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Nordoff & Robbins Ozzy Osbourne Memorial Handicap

runners_data.name: Into The Light
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong recent form for in-form Appleby/Buick combination, well-suited to this trip and tactics

runners_data.name: Lost Boys
runners_data.note: Returns after 209-day break but showed ability in softer company, needs to prove fitness against this level

runners_data.name: Colourband
runners_data.note: Natural front runner in good form with recent win on similar going, well-positioned tactically as the pace setter

runners_data.name: The Joker
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after lengthy break but carries 4lbs less than main rivals, form needs updating

runners_data.name: Bnaider
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist faces difficult task from rear in small field, needs strong pace to be effective

runners_data.name: Magic Trip
runners_data.note: Recent runner whose hold-up style is compromised by lack of early pace, low TopSpeed rating a concern

races.paceDynamic: Colourband will make the early running with Into The Light and Lost Boys tracking close behind, creating a genuine pace in this competitive handicap. The Joker will also settle prominently, leaving hold-up horses Bnaider and Magic Trip with work to do from the rear. With four prominent runners and only two hold-up horses, the pace will be solid throughout the 1m2f trip. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can position handy and kick clear, rather than the hold-up horses who face a tough task from the back of a small field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays genuine but not overly strong
scenarios.body: Colourband, Into The Light, and Lost Boys control the race from the front, with one of them proving strongest in the final furlong. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground against the well-positioned leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong
scenarios.body: The prominent runners go too fast early, allowing Magic Trip or Bnaider to close strongly from the rear. The pace collapse benefits the patient hold-up horses who time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Colourband dictates a steady tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The confirmed front runner controls the race at a manageable pace, gradually increasing the tempo to wear down rivals. Her stamina and tactical advantage from the front proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Confusion Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners hesitate or mark each other
scenarios.body: The four prominent runners become too tactical, allowing an unfancied runner to steal a march. The disrupted pace dynamics create an upset opportunity.

watchPoints.text: Into The Light and Colourband settling too close together early could create unnecessary pressure and compromise both chances
Lost Boys showing any signs of rustiness after 209-day layoff in the early stages of the race
Magic Trip and Bnaider being too far back at halfway with limited pace to aim at in this small field
The Joker's fitness levels after 175 days off, particularly in the final two furlongs
Colourband's ability to sustain her front-running tactics against better opposition than recent wins
